opportunities.title: Steal Daggerheart's 30-Second Monster Trick for Your 5e Table
opportunities.why_now: Sly Flourish just published a lazy-monster-building method that's a direct crossover with the improvised-creature shorts this channel already runs.
opportunities.angle: Side-by-side short: show the Daggerheart 'name a trait, roll a d6' method, then translate it into a Shadowdark or 5e stat-block on the fly for a random encounter.

opportunities.title: The Thri-Kreen Ambush Tactic Dark Sun's Original Creators Are Bringing Back
opportunities.why_now: EN World's podcast just revealed Dark Sun's original designers are building a new setting, giving a hook to revisit one of D&D's most brutal monster ecologies.
opportunities.angle: Creature tactic short: break down thri-kreen pack-hunting/ambush mechanics from Dark Sun lore and how to run them as a lethal 5e/DCC encounter today.

opportunities.title: Why New D&D Video Games Always Fumble Concentration Checks
opportunities.why_now: The same EN World podcast teased upcoming D&D video games, a timely peg to correct a mechanic Hollywood/game adaptations constantly botch.
opportunities.angle: Rules-ruling short: quote the actual concentration save wording, then clip a common video-game misrepresentation and explain the correct tabletop resolution.

opportunities.title: Arcana Unleashed Leak: The Spell Option That Could Break Your Table
opportunities.why_now: Arcana Unleashed was just previewed on EN World's podcast, making this the freshest new-content preview to speculate on before official rules drop.
opportunities.angle: Spell use-case short: pick a leaked/previewed option and stress-test it against action economy and existing broken combos (e.g., Twinned Spell abuse) with a ruling verdict.

opportunities.title: Skip the Podcast: One Ruling a Day Beats an Hour of Talk
opportunities.why_now: EN World's 'Launch Your Own Podcast' piece is trending advice for GMs building an audience, making this the moment for a wry counter-take from a channel that already does it in seconds.
opportunities.angle: Meta/engagement short: dry veteran-GM monologue on why a single mechanical ruling delivered fast outperforms long-form podcast chatter, ending with a call to subscribe for daily rulings.
